reference.spin_basis: Neutral isolated Li ground state is a doublet. The paper specifies the isolated neutral atom reference; the spin assignment is a physical identity inference, not a quoted input line.

xyz_convention: coordinates are Cartesian Angstrom; periodic cell vectors are supplied here; add vacuum along z before calculation
method_freedom: choose and justify a computational method; do not assume the paper protocol is mandatory
periodic_spin_treatment: Metallic periodic slabs have no prescribed molecular multiplicity; document the chosen spin treatment. This is distinct from the isolated atom.
stacking: ABCAB (fcc Cu(111)); layers ordered bottom to top
coordinate_note: Source-aligned fcc stacking and hollow registry. Initial z positions are construction guesses, not claimed author-optimized distances; preserve the specified relaxation boundary.
